items.question: Which sacred site grants accomplishment to practitioners of the left-hand path?
premises: Pūrṇagiri is named as a sacred site.
The left-hand path is specified as the recipient tradition.
The site is described as granting accomplishment.
items.inference: Pūrṇagiri bestows accomplishment upon followers of the left-hand path.
uncertainties: The plural form siddhidāḥ may echo the previous verse's predicate structure.
items.plain_english: Pūrṇagiri grants accomplishment to those of the left-hand path.
